title: NASA OSTEM Internship — Spring 2027
shortDescription: Paid, mentor-led internships on NASA projects during the Spring 2027 session.
fullDescription: NASA Office of STEM Engagement (OSTEM) internships place college students on real agency projects with NASA mentors. The Spring session typically runs about 15 weeks (mid-January to early May). Most interns receive a stipend based on academic level and session length. Apply through NASA STEM Gateway. U.S. citizenship is required.
eligibility: U.S. citizen; at least 16; college student (undergraduate through graduate) with a cumulative 3.0 GPA on a 4.0 scale; enrolled at a U.S.-accredited institution.

title: NASA OSTEM Internship — Summer 2027
shortDescription: Paid summer internships contributing to NASA missions under a NASA mentor.
fullDescription: NASA OSTEM Summer internships are typically about 10 weeks (late May through August). Interns work on agency projects in STEM and some non-STEM fields. Apply through NASA STEM Gateway. U.S. citizenship is required. Check individual project listings for location and hybrid options.
eligibility: U.S. citizen; at least 16; college student with a 3.0 GPA; enrolled at a U.S.-accredited college or university.

title: Kaggriculture
shortDescription: Build an AI agent that runs a virtual farm and competes on a live leaderboard.
fullDescription: A Kaggle featured simulation competition. Design, build, and deploy an autonomous agent to manage a virtual farm, trade on a dynamic market, and maximize profit over a simulated season. Entry and team-merger deadline is 23 September 2026; final submission deadline is 30 September 2026 (11:59 PM UTC).
eligibility: Open to Kaggle users who accept the competition rules before the entry deadline. Check Kaggle for prize and team-size rules.

title: ARC Prize 2026 — ARC-AGI-3
shortDescription: Kaggle competition for abstract reasoning systems on ARC-AGI-3 tasks.
fullDescription: ARC Prize 2026 (ARC-AGI-3) is a Kaggle competition on abstract reasoning. Entry and team-merger deadline is 26 October 2026; final submission deadline is 2 November 2026. Winners announcement listed as 4 December 2026. Confirm prize and eligibility on the official Kaggle page.
eligibility: Open to Kaggle users who accept the competition rules before the entry deadline. Review official rules for prize eligibility.
